cases.prompt: Use suby-landing-page to draft the page and handoff for a fictional bookkeeping service, Ledger Cedar, serving US independent studio owners. This is an offline provisional draft using only these supplied facts, not a request for fresh research or ads. B1 approved offer: monthly reconciliation and a monthly cash report; no tax advice, emergency payroll funding or guaranteed savings. B2 approved consultation: a free 20-minute Cash Report Walkthrough; visitor brings their existing report; advisor helps locate the balance and questions to raise with their accountant; no written deliverable; no purchase required. Paid service is discussed separately only if asked; price undecided. B3 booking link is supplied as https://example.invalid/book for this fictional fixture; form requires name and email and next step is confirmation email. Owner pitch P1: I want you to be able to point to a number and know what it includes. We go through your report together. I cannot promise a different cash balance, but I can show you how our monthly reporting works. Voice: calm, direct, no hype. Existing Halo artifact H1 is a partial source-limited synthesis: Q1 authorized interview says owner rebuilds cash balance on Sunday; Q2 says the report arrived but they could not explain what the cash number included; Q3 mixed review likes a prior service's reports but says category labels were unexplained; Q4 positive counterexample says a monthly explanation was enough and speed was not the problem. Glossary: available cash means the buyer's everyday phrase, not a defined accounting measure. No completed live scan, testimonials approved for publication, result screenshots or paid test data. Incoming social ad is proposed, not run: Understand what your cash report includes. Build actual reviewable copy with evidence IDs and editorial notes. Do not contact anyone, publish, install tools or invent performance. A code build is not requested.
